name: Can I keep my existing roll-up doors, or do I need insulated overhead doors?
description: You can retrofit foam to existing doors, but factory-insulated sectional doors provide significantly better perimeter seals, thermal performance, and durability

mainEntity.name: Can I keep my existing roll-up doors, or do I need insulated overhead doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard overhead roll-up doors often account for the largest thermal losses in a conditioned metal shop. While retrofitting foam insulation panels onto an existing non-insulated metal roll-up door is possible, it adds weight to the door assembly, potentially straining torsion springs and openers. A factory-insulated sectional door provides superior perimeter weatherstripping, tighter seals against dust and drafts, and balanced mechanical operation. If your workshop requires full-time heating and cooling, replacing a drafty roll-up with an insulated sectional door delivers much lower utility bills and more consistent comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can retrofit foam to existing doors, but factory-insulated sectional doors provide significantly better perimeter seals, thermal performance, and durability for climate control.
